description:
The total for one stay at one New Leaf property: the nights, the tax and what is paid at the property. Asks that property live and returns its quote, with source attribution on booking links, so the figure is the one its booking form uses, and passes on its refusal when a stay cannot be sold. Requires the property, room type and dates. It gives a Twin Falls price and does not establish room availability. High Country returns an estimated subtotal, three tax lines and total from its current published rates; staff confirm the exact rate and total. High Country Motel, 766 S Main St, Bellevue, Idaho, about 64 road miles north of Twin Falls, is also run by New Leaf Properties.
Rates from $115 a night, $600 a week, $1,490 a month, plus applicable taxes. Subject to availability.
Single accommodates 1 to 2 guests; Double accommodates 1 to 4 guests. Half-kitchenette mini suites are Doubles.
High Country taxes total 11% for stays of 30 days or less: Idaho sales 6%, Idaho travel and convention 2%, and Bellevue local option 3%. Longer continuous stays may be exempt; ask the front desk.
Estimated price, based on our starting rates. The front desk will confirm your exact rate and total, including all applicable taxes, before your stay. No payment is taken online. The Twin Falls rates and tax do not apply.
Front desk: (208) 721-0067. New Leaf office: (208) 733-2010.
Book online, by phone at (208) 721-0067, or through booking-enabled chat. Your request requires staff confirmation. Chat stays are capped at 30 nights; longer stays through the front desk. Book a room: https://highcountrymotelid.com/reserve.html
